description: Search hundreds of tutorials and articles on kirupa.com covering JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML5 Canvas, animations, React, and data structures & algorithms using full-text search (FTS5 + BM25). Returns matching tutorials with canonical URLs, clean Markdown URLs, matching section headings, and excerpts.

limit.description: Maximum number of tutorials to return (1 to 15, default 5).

query.description: Keywords, concept, or technical question to search for (e.g. "requestAnimationFrame delta time", "quicksort", "canvas starfield", "closures").

section.description: Optional section filter: data_structures_algorithms, javascript, html5, canvas, animations, react, codingexercises, ai, product_development, podcast, or hodgepodge.

name: search_tutorials
title: Search kirupa.com Tutorials & Articles
